import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXV = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static char[][] a = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] b = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] infect = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, T;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static boolean isDigit0(char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }
    static boolean isDigit1(char c) { return c >= '1' && c <= '9'; }

    static class Dinic {
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj;
        int[][] cap;
        int[] dist;
        boolean[] used;

        Dinic() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAXV];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXV; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            cap = new int[MAXV][MAXV];
            dist = new int[MAXV];
            used = new boolean[MAXV];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            adj[u].add(v);
            adj[v].add(u);
            cap[u][v] = c;
            cap[v][u] = 0;
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            dist[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && dist[t] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v : adj[u]) {
                    if (cap[u][v] > 0 && dist[v] == -1) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            used[u] = true;
            for (int v : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] > 0 && !used[v] && dist[v] == dist[u] + 1) {
                    int got = dfs(v, t, Math.min(flow, cap[u][v]));
                    if (got > 0) {
                        cap[u][v] -= got;
                        cap[v][u] += got;
                        return got;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int ret = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(used, false);
                int got;
                while ((got = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) ret += got;
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static Dinic dinic = new Dinic();

    static void zombieBFS(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(infect[i], INF);
        infect[sx][sy] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (isDigit0(a[nx][ny]) && infect[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    infect[nx][ny] = infect[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addSourceEdges(int sx, int sy) {
        int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;

        if (isDigit1(b[sx][sy]))
            dinic.addEdge(n * sx + sy, n * n + n * sx + sy, INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (dist[nx][ny] != INF) continue;
                if (!isDigit0(a[nx][ny])) continue;

                int cur = dist[x][y] + 1;
                if (cur <= Math.min(infect[nx][ny] - 1, T)) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = cur;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
                if (cur <= Math.min(infect[nx][ny], T) && isDigit1(b[nx][ny]))
                    dinic.addEdge(n * sx + sy, n * n + n * nx + ny, INF);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        int zx = 0, zy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i; zy = j;
                } else if (isDigit1(a[i][j])) {
                    dinic.addEdge(MAXV - 2, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        zombieBFS(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (isDigit1(b[i][j]))
                    dinic.addEdge(n * n + i * n + j, MAXV - 1, b[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (isDigit1(a[i][j])) addSourceEdges(i, j);

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(MAXV - 2, MAXV - 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
